rationale: Re-reviewed compiler-convert after the #544 review fixes (convert-to-jess.ts, sandbox-route.ts, index.ts, convert-to-jess.test.ts). printConversion still takes each converted document's projection only from its own plugin (context.pluginOf(document)?.jessFunctions?.()) and passes it unchanged as emitJess's functions option; no #less/#sass projection or name map is built in the consumer, and the owner is not imported. The changes stay in consumer-owned scope: which sources it converts (loaded files claim their paths first; collisions and every import of a losing file are gaps), import paths (importPathFrom split out), CSS @import prelude placement (preludeImportOf), the render profile, and the engine-result check (sources inside host-computed read roots, host-derived jessPath). The wrapper/copy/unusedImport alternatives' anchor lines are unchanged in the source.
